83999.commentary: (VINa) ṭhapitaṃ hoti pātimokkhan'ti ettha pure vā pacchā vā ṭhapitam'pi aṭṭhapitaṃ hoti, khette ṭhapitam'eva pana ṭhapitaṃ nāma hoti. tasmā suṇātu me, bhante saṅgho, ajj'uposatho pannaraso, yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho uposathaṃ kareyyā'ti ettha yāva re-kāraṃ bhaṇati, tāva ṭhapetabbaṃ, idañ'hi khettaṃ. yya-kāre pana vutte ṭhapentena pacchā ṭhapitaṃ nāma hoti. suṇātu me'ti anāraddhe'y'eva ṭhapentena pure ṭhapitaṃ hoti.
